$switch.relation_type == 'SYNONYM': The target sense must express essentially the same lexicalized concept as the source sense.
$switch.relation_type == 'ANTONYM': The target sense must express an opposing meaning to the source sense on the relevant semantic dimension.
$switch.relation_type == 'HYPERNYM': The source sense must denote a kind or type of the target sense.
$switch.relation_type == 'HYPONYM': The target sense must denote a kind or type of the source sense.
$switch.relation_type == 'MERONYM': The target sense must denote a part, member, or substance of what the source sense denotes.
$switch.relation_type == 'HOLONYM': What the source sense denotes must be a part, member, or substance of what the target sense denotes.

matched_sense.instructions: Which candidate sense of target.word satisfies relation.rule with the source sense? Compare lexical meanings, not wording overlap or general association. Choose no_candidate if none forms the required relation. If several candidates qualify, choose the most directly equivalent endpoint.

initial.no_candidate: No candidate sense forms the required semantic relation with the source sense.
